7040e153e7.q: What engineering solutions is EBS implementing to address data center water consumption and cooling challenges?
7040e153e7.a: EBS addresses water consumption through multiple approaches: recycling water already being used (as demonstrated in Norway where used water heats buildings), selecting appropriate sites for data centers especially in cooler areas, and exploring air-cooled data center options. Additionally, EBS's battery group has investigated liquid-cooled options beyond water-based cooling, including products from 3M for better liquid cooling solutions. EBS provides ideas to developers and EPCs on how to improve cooling efficiency while working on power generation, power delivery, and site selection.

e1c6c37374.q: What uptime reliability requirements do data centers require for behind-the-meter microgrid systems?
e1c6c37374.a: Data centers require 99.9999% uptime, which equates to approximately one hour of allowable downtime per year. This extremely high reliability standard makes microgrid implementation expensive and requires cooperation from utilities and grid operators. Some data center owners have negotiated lower uptime percentages like 99.999% or 99.99%, which significantly reduces solution costs, but major tech companies typically demand the highest decimal precision at 99.9999%.
